meta.display_guidance: Scores are provisional, explainable similarity values for one mission test at a time. Show them with score_range, coverage, confidence and contributions. Do not present them as a final ranking or as proof that a site is equivalent to the target.
meta.score_definition: score = sum(w*c*s)/sum(w*c) over available parameters; w = declared weight, c = comparability factor (1.0 comparable, 0.5 partial), s = per-parameter similarity in [0,1].
meta.coverage_definition: share of the test's declared weight whose parameters were available on both sides.
meta.score_range_definition: min/max score over Earth window 5/10/20 km and similarity tolerances (log-ratio k 2/3/5, abs tolerance x0.67/1/1.5).
meta.sensitive_to_assumptions_definition: true when score_range is wider than 0.4; confidence is then capped at 'low'.

targets.name: Lunar south polar region 80-90 S (regional, not a landing site)

mission_tests.rationale: Traverse difficulty is driven mainly by typical slope, the steep tail of slopes, and surface roughness. Soil bearing strength and rock abundance would matter too but are not in the dataset.
Hazard-detection algorithms are exercised by how much of the area is too steep, by small-scale roughness, and by local relief. Boulder counts are not in the dataset.

mission_tests.label_en: Lighting / low-Sun imaging and solar geometry
mission_tests.rationale: Shadow length and camera/navigation lighting depend on Sun elevation. This is pure geometry: it does NOT say the site is a terrain or environmental analog.

Hardware thermal testing depends on the temperature extremes and mean. Only partially comparable (MODIS skin LST vs Diviner). No Mars surface-temperature product is in the dataset, so this test is not offered for Mars.

slope_median_deg.method: arctan(|grad z|) on a DEM resampled to the common grid spacing; median over valid pixels (Earth: 10 km x 10 km window centred on the site; Mars: HiRISE footprint; Moon region: median of 10 km windows)
slope_median_deg.limitations: Slope depends on grid spacing; values at 30/80 m are smoother than rover-wheel scale. Earth DSM includes vegetation/buildings; HiRISE is stereo photogrammetry, Copernicus is InSAR, LOLA is laser altimetry.

slope_p90_deg.method: 90th percentile of the same slope field

frac_slope_gt_15.label_en: Fraction of area steeper than 15 deg
frac_slope_gt_15.method: share of valid slope pixels > 15 deg
frac_slope_gt_15.limitations: 15 deg is a declared engineering threshold (order of typical rover/lander slope limits), not a mission requirement.

roughness_rms_m.method: RMS of (z minus 5x5 local mean) in a 5x5 window, median over valid pixels. Window = 150 m at 30 m spacing (Mars comparisons), 400 m at 80 m (Moon comparisons).
roughness_rms_m.limitations: Not comparable to roughness_10m/50m/100m in mars_site_metrics.csv (different method and scale).

relief_5km_m.label_en: Local relief (p95 - p5 in 5 km tiles)
relief_5km_m.method: elevation p95 minus p5 inside each 5 km x 5 km tile with >= 80% valid pixels; median over tiles
relief_5km_m.limitations: Few tiles per Earth window/Mars footprint (about 2-6), so this is sensitive to where the window falls. Partial.

sun_noon_elev_max_deg.label_en: Highest noon Sun elevation over the year
sun_noon_elev_max_deg.method: Geometry only: 90 - max(0, |lat| - obliquity). Obliquity: Earth 23.44, Mars 25.19, Moon 1.54 deg.
sun_noon_elev_max_deg.limitations: Ignores terrain horizon, atmosphere and day length (Mars sol 24.6 h, lunar day ~29.5 Earth days).

sun_noon_elev_min_deg.label_en: Lowest noon Sun elevation over the year
sun_noon_elev_min_deg.method: Geometry only: 90 - (|lat| + obliquity); negative means the Sun stays below the horizon at noon (polar night).

temp_max_K.method: Earth: max over 2024 of the monthly MODIS MOD11A2 daytime LST, window mean within 5 km. Moon: Diviner PRP regional mean of annual max surface temperature.
temp_max_K.limitations: Different measurement (MODIS skin LST vs Diviner model product), 1 km vs polar elements, atmosphere vs vacuum. Partial.

temp_mean_K.method: Earth: mean of monthly day and night MODIS LST (2024; devon_haughton 2023). Moon: Diviner PRP regional mean of annual-average temperature at 2 cm depth.
temp_mean_K.limitations: Skin temperature vs 2 cm depth; 12 eight-day composites vs climatology. Partial.

solar_irradiance_kwh_m2_day.limitations: No Mars or Moon surface irradiance product in the dataset, so it is shown as Earth context and never scored.

dust_optical_depth.method: LMD MY36 dust climatology, nearest ~3 deg cell (Mars only).
dust_optical_depth.limitations: No Earth aerosol product in the dataset; atmospheric dust, not dust on equipment.

sun_visibility_fraction.method: LOLA AVGVISIB_85S_060M (scale 4e-05) regional mean, Moon only.
sun_visibility_fraction.limitations: Includes terrain shadowing; no equivalent Earth product, so context only.
